verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser's own Visalaw AI pages say what the AI automates in petition work: drafting petition letters and briefs, analyzing documents and RFEs, and automating workflows. They also publish an AI posture covering SOC 2 Type II and no data retention. Nothing in the pack explains how the firm uses that AI in its own client petitions or what an attorney reviews. missing for 10: a statement of human attorney review or sign-off, a description of the firm's own AI use in client petition drafting and review, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
